evidenceLevel: Human-reviewed public acceptance summary only; no raw receipts or internal coverage matrix.
packageScope: New audited Windows portable package with a narrowly scoped desktop-pet context-menu fix; tested on a disposable cloud runner using isolated offline fixtures, not user devices or production cloud.

acceptanceConclusion.comparison: Previously accepted 56 original cases remain source-bound after impact review; D07 adds one. This does not mean 57 full cases were rerun on the new package.
acceptanceConclusion.executionDistinction: One original case was fully exercised on this new package. The other 56 accepted cases retain exact-version prior evidence, with reviewed unaffected paths or explicitly mixed affected-path support. Incomplete cases remain incomplete.

newPackageFindings.D07: Normal quiet, wandering and cursor-follow behavior, actual right-click menu cancellation, interaction affecting only the intended pet, and recall of only that pet satisfy the original case.
newPackageFindings.D02: One actual affected-path drag shows no accidental interaction. Combined with prior complete repeated-drag evidence and unchanged geometry paths, acceptance is retained as mixed/reused support—not a new ten-drag test.
newPackageFindings.D08: Only own-pet hit/miss after closing the menu was exercised. Full-screen and other-application behavior remain unverified; case remains partial.

impactQualification: Product changes are confined to the desktop pet renderer and its scoped menu styling. Unchanged account, backup, resource-management, cloud, battle, garden, main-window navigation, settings and tray paths retain earlier evidence and its original limitations. Prior desktop geometry and restart results are retained with explicit mixed support, not presented as new-package reruns.
publicationBoundary: The complete versioned matrix and detailed execution evidence remain local and are not published here. Public traceability is limited to the existing workflow artifact and whole-archive checksum.
